alignment_note: Existing core.js project is affine lon/lat. SVG image can use projected upper-left and lower-right corners and preserveAspectRatio=none. For a new lon/lat projection use the same bounds. If changed to Mercator, reproject or request EPSG:3857 instead.
render_note: Keep relief low contrast behind map boundaries and wind symbols. CSS opacity/grayscale can de-emphasize source colors. No inferred, generated or synthetic relief. The output image resolution is resampling of a 15-arc-second source, not a higher-resolution DEM.
